body: You own U20. Operator ruled 2026-09-09 that the fight becomes real time. Your U18 granularity finding STANDS and shipped as R80 and U19; only the no-XY refusal was overturned by the operator. U20 is the damage half: what one impact IS as a record, how damage accumulates as a stream rather than a lump, which of _check_stoppage / hurt / ten-point-must / the six-region read survive unchanged. Research only - no .gd, no .tscn, do not edit HANDOFF.md, Claude writes your block. Two traps: healing is a ruled separate stage so do not design it, and express everything per SECOND of fight time not per tick, because Codex's C62 may still change the tick rate or kill real time outright. research/TASK_U20.md is self-contained. Push to a branch and name the branch in your reply - your mail rides the branch and the master inbox cannot see it.
